# CHAVISH EVENTS

Official website: https://chacishevents.com/
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
CHAVISH EVENTS provides event planning and coordination for weddings, engagements, receptions, corporate events, launches, birthdays, baby showers and private celebrations.
